name: @guide/forge
description: Forge — multi-database wrapper with Prisma-shape API. Selects adapter from connection-string prefix; drivers are optional peer dependencies.

scripts.forge:integration: npm run forge:integration:sqlite && npm run forge:integration:pg && npm run forge:integration:mysql && npm run forge:integration:mongo
scripts.forge:bench:sqlite: SKIP_PG=1 SKIP_MYSQL=1 SKIP_MONGO=1 ts-node --transpile-only --project tsconfig.json bench/db-bench.ts
scripts.forge:bench:pg: SKIP_SQLITE=1 SKIP_MYSQL=1 SKIP_MONGO=1 ts-node --transpile-only --project tsconfig.json bench/db-bench.ts
scripts.forge:bench:mysql: SKIP_SQLITE=1 SKIP_PG=1 SKIP_MONGO=1 ts-node --transpile-only --project tsconfig.json bench/db-bench.ts
scripts.forge:bench:mongo: SKIP_SQLITE=1 SKIP_PG=1 SKIP_MYSQL=1 ts-node --transpile-only --project tsconfig.json bench/db-bench.ts
scripts.forge:bench:compare:pg: COMPARE=1 SKIP_SQLITE=1 SKIP_MYSQL=1 SKIP_MONGO=1 ts-node --transpile-only --project tsconfig.json bench/db-bench.ts
scripts.forge:bench:compare:mysql: COMPARE=1 SKIP_SQLITE=1 SKIP_PG=1 SKIP_MONGO=1 ts-node --transpile-only --project tsconfig.json bench/db-bench.ts
scripts.forge:bench:compare:sqlite: COMPARE=1 SKIP_PG=1 SKIP_MYSQL=1 SKIP_MONGO=1 ts-node --transpile-only --project tsconfig.json bench/db-bench.ts
scripts.forge:bench:compare:mongo: COMPARE=1 SKIP_SQLITE=1 SKIP_PG=1 SKIP_MYSQL=1 ts-node --transpile-only --project tsconfig.json bench/db-bench.ts
scripts.forge:bench:compare:gen: prisma generate --schema=bench/compare/pg.prisma && prisma generate --schema=bench/compare/mysql.prisma && prisma generate --schema=bench/compare/sqlite.prisma
scripts.forge:check: npm run forge:test && npm run forge:typesafety && npm run forge:autocomplete
scripts.forge:all: npm run forge:check && npm run forge:integration && npm run forge:bench
